blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: NHRC recommendations are purely advisory and NOT binding on the government.
The commission lacks the authority to directly punish human rights violators.
NHRC is barred from inquiring into any case after the expiry of one year from the date of incident.
The powers and jurisdiction of NHRC regarding human rights violations by armed forces are restricted.
Questions often test the 1-year time limit limitation for NHRC to take up a case.
Remember that NHRC cannot directly award punishment or monetary relief; it can only make recommendations.
Note the limited role of NHRC concerning human rights violations committed by members of the armed forces.
